basic_info.description: Perched on a coveted street, this exquisitely maintained 1930s home offers panoramic southeastern VIEWS that stretch gracefully across the city culminating in a front-row seat to Downtown San Francisco's iconic skyline. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, the home unfolds with warmth and charm across every level. The main level offers an oversized kitchen that is flooded with light from a large, central skylight. Just off the kitchen, a charming dining nook flows seamlessly to an outdoor view deck ideal for enjoying breakfast indoors or al fresco. The FDR is also bathed in light and framed by gorgeous arched doorways. Two bedrooms on this main lvl, one with fireplace; both with beautiful green outlooks. On the lower level, a sunlit bedroom with attached office opens to a private deck, offering yet another stunning vantage point of the surrounding views. You'll also find a spacious flex room opens directly to a lush, mature garden sanctuary, a rare urban retreat and a true delight for the discerning gardener or entertainer. The hallmarks of vintage craftsmanship: original hardwood floors, arched doorways, and elegant architectural details throughout this home add to its peaceful presence. A true gem in Noe Valley.
